transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... well, I guess I'm just dealing with this... restless feeling. It's like I'm wound a bit too tight, I suppose. I just can't really seem to fully settle down. Even when I'm supposed to be sitting calmly... like in a planning meeting for work, or... if I try to paint, or do yoga. I just... yeah. That's mainly why I'm here.
Do you find yourself having repetitive thoughts that are hard to stop?
No... I don't think so. I don't really get stuck on thoughts like that. It's mostly just... what I mentioned before.
Do you often feel tired?
No, not really. I mean... I sleep okay, usually. I don't feel particularly exhausted during the day. It's just... the restlessness.
Do you experience any physical symptoms like tension or pain in your body?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't have any aches or pain or anything like that. My body feels fine, I guess. It's just what I said before.
Do you find yourself avoiding certain activities or situations because of this restless feeling?
No... not really. I mean, I still do what I have to do. I don't avoid things, I just... I just feel it while I'm doing them, I guess.
Do you feel anxious?
Um... no. I wouldn't say I feel anxious. I don't really worry about things... it's not like that. It's just that restless feeling.
Have you experienced a loss of interest in activities you normally enjoy?
No... I haven't noticed that. I still like doing the same things, I guess. Nothing's really changed there.
How long have you been experiencing this restless feeling?

Um... maybe a little over two years? Like two years and two months, I guess. It just... it got noticeably harder to manage around then. We were just dealing with some... family things. In-law conflicts that started taking up a lot of our evenings. So... yeah, since about then.
Do you feel like you're able to experience a full range of emotions?
Um... yeah, I suppose so. I haven't really noticed any issues with... my emotions, or anything like that. It all seems fine, I guess.
Do you ever feel like you're just going through the motions of daily life without really feeling connected to what's happening around you?
No, I... I wouldn't say that. I mean, I feel connected enough to... things. It's just normal life, really. I don't feel disconnected or anything.
Do you feel like you're able to experience strong emotions, like happiness or sadness, as intensely as you used to?
Um... yes. I think so. I haven't really noticed any difference in how I feel things. It all seems about the same.
Do you feel like your emotions have been muted or less intense than they used to be?
No... I don't think so. Like I said, it all just feels normal to me. Nothing really feels muted or... different.
Do you feel like you've lost the ability to feel pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
No... not really. I still enjoy the things I usually do. I haven't noticed any change with that.
Do you ever feel detached from yourself or your surroundings?
No... I don't think so. I don't really know what you mean by that, but... no. I'm just here. Nothing like that.
Do you feel like things that used to upset you or make you angry don't have as much of an effect on you anymore?
No... if something is upsetting, it still bothers me. I haven't noticed a change there either.
Do you often feel guilty about things?
Um, no. I don't... I don't really struggle with that. Just the normal amount, I guess, but not often.
Do you feel like you're less emotional than you used to be?
No, I wouldn't say that. I'm about the same.
Does your restless feeling tend to be worse at specific times of the day?
Um, not really. I haven't noticed it being worse at any... particular time. I guess it just happens whenever.
Has this restless feeling interfered with your relationships or work in any way?

Um... I suppose a little. At work, I've had to go back and correct some purchase orders... so my planning coordinator does a bit of extra review on my stuff now. And at home... I guess family dinners can get kind of tense. They say I tend to talk over people. But... yeah, that's mostly it.
Do you feel like you're unable to feel emotions as strongly as other people do?
No... I don't think so. I feel things just fine, I guess. Same as anyone else.
